reply_text:
Then we'll avoid copying out of the terminal. I've put Zone's public key on a web page: **https://zone.hyperreal.enterprises/wip/zone-key.txt**. Open it in your phone's browser, copy it from there, and paste it into Linode under profile → **LISH Console Settings** → **Authorized Keys**. Then tell me your Linode username (just typing it is fine), and I'll connect to the console from Zone and do the rest myself. After that, nothing needs copying back from the box.

On tmux: `set -g mouse off` is already in `~/.tmux.conf`, added on 23 September for exactly this reason, so something else must be blocking copy. I'll leave it for now and can look at it once metameso is back up.
